sections.title: Types of Bone Fractures
points: Simple: Bone breaks but stays inside the flesh.
Compound: Bone breaks and pierces the skin (Bleeding occurs).
Greenstick: Bone bends or cracks but does not break fully (Common in children).
Comminuted: Bone is shattered into several small pieces.

sections.title: First Aid Mastery
points: Splint: A stiff support used to keep broken bones from moving during transport.
Arm Sling: Used to support and rest a broken arm or sprained wrist.
Stretcher: Essential for patients with spinal injuries to prevent permanent paralysis.

sections.text: For dislocations or sprains, use the RICE method: Rest, Ice (reduce swelling), Compress (bandage), Elevate (lift above heart)!

cards.fact: When bones at a joint are forced out of place.
cards.mnemonic: Think: 'Dis-Located' — the bone is in the wrong location!

cards.fact: Used on compound fractures to prevent infection.
